subject.description: The subject line of the email.

body.description: The main content of the email. Plain text or HTML content is expected.

cc_address.description: The email address to be included in the CC field. Format should be a valid email address, such as 'example@domain.com'.

bcc_address.description: The email address to be included in the BCC field. Format should be a valid email address, such as 'example@domain.com'.

attachments.description: A list of file paths or URLs for files to be attached to the email.
